text: Figure 9.26: Interfaces required by Communication Management Interface Purpose CryptoStack Communication Management shall use this interface to establish encrypted connections and generate / verify checksums (MAC). EventReporter This interface should be used to report security events. FVM Communication Management shall use this interface to get freshness values. Logger Communication Management shall use this interface to log standardized messages. Manifest Accessor Communication Management shall use this interface to read service information from the Manifests. OperatingSystemInterface Communication Management should use this interface to create and control Threads used by the implementation. PolicyDecisionPoint Communication Management shall use this interface to check access to ara::com service methods, fields, and events.
